common: Cinematic painted video game concept art, single full-bleed widescreen frame. Muted blue-teal night palette, warm amber windows, soft film grain, tactile detailed painterly style. Main subject centered and upper-middle, bottom quarter quiet dark ground, upper-right corner quiet empty sky. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no border, no watermark, no gore.

images.subject: The house walks a circular road under a huge glowing cyan ring of light; translucent ghost copies of the house repeat along the ring (the time loop).
The house from behind at the end of a long ruined road, looking at the far dispatch tower whose top holds a glowing white-cyan core; a faint pink line of dawn on the horizon.
Panorama from a height: one road through three districts, orange rusty quarter, green glowing greenhouse domes, cyan network towers; the tiny house walks along it.
Nine neighbours at a long table on the roof garden under lanterns, tea cups and one extra empty tenth cup, a ginger cat on a chair.
The first real sunrise: the resting house on a flowering hilltop, neighbours opening windows, the cyan ring fading in the golden clouds, the dark calm tower far behind.

note: The prompts were written in English for the model; each starts with the 'common' paragraph's style words and then names the subject above in detail (the house is the old Soviet concrete block on mechanical legs with plants, laundry, a blue-and-yellow flag, solar panels and small cannons).
